title: Episode 87: Special Guest Tony Van Eerd! (Part 4)

sentences.en: ADSP, the podcast, episode 87, recorded on June 24th, 2022.
sentences.zh: ADSP 播客第 87 期，录制于 2022 年 6 月 24 日。

sentences.en: My name is Connor, and today with my co-host, Bryce, we finish part four of our four-part interview with Tony Van Heer.
sentences.zh: 我是康纳，今天和我的联合主持人布赖斯一起，完成我们对托尼·范·赫尔的四期访谈的第四部分。

sentences.en: So my sister had a dog like that, Australian sheepdog or whatever.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐以前有一只那样的狗，澳大利亚牧羊犬什么的。

sentences.en: Super smart, right?
sentences.zh: 超级聪明，对吧？

sentences.en: Super smart dog.
sentences.zh: 超级聪明的狗。

sentences.en: Yeah, they're very smart dogs.
sentences.zh: 对，它们是非常聪明的狗。

sentences.en: And friendliest dog in the world, you know?
sentences.zh: 而且是世界上最友善的狗，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And then I go over to my sister's house one day, and nobody, you know, I knock on the back door, and it's like, it doesn't seem like anyone's home or whatever.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天我去我姐姐家，没有人，你知道的，我敲了后门，感觉好像家里没人什么的。

sentences.en: And I think I was dropping something off or something.
sentences.zh: 我想我可能是去送个东西什么的。

sentences.en: So I just, like, open up the back door, and I'm like, hey, is anyone home today and everything, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我直接推开后门，然后说，嘿，今天有人在家吗之类的，对吧？

sentences.en: And I'm looking around, and I was like,
sentences.zh: 我四处看了看，心想，

sentences.en: I'll just put this thing on this table or whatever.
sentences.zh: 我就把这东西放在这张桌子上或者哪儿好了。

sentences.en: And then I noticed the dog is not barking and trying to, like, protect the house.
sentences.zh: 然后我注意到那只狗没有叫，也没有试图去保护房子。

sentences.en: The dog is trying to sneak up on me.
sentences.zh: 这只狗正试图悄悄靠近我。

sentences.en: It's just like coming, I saw it sneak around a corner, and then it just, like, backed away a little bit.
sentences.zh: 它就像是走过来，我看到它从一个拐角处溜过来，然后稍微往后退了一点。

sentences.en: And it's like, the dog was like, I'm like, this dog knows me.
sentences.zh: 感觉这只狗在想……我觉得，这只狗认识我。

sentences.en: It should be, you know, hey, Tony, blah, blah, blah, and wagging its tail.
sentences.zh: 它本该说，你知道的，嘿，托尼，巴拉巴拉，然后摇尾巴。

sentences.en: It's like, no.
sentences.zh: 结果并没有。

sentences.en: Right now it is in protection mode.
sentences.zh: 它现在处于戒备状态。

sentences.en: She was flanking you.
sentences.zh: 它在包抄你。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Like, totally.
sentences.zh: 简直是。

sentences.en: This dog, Looney, is a very smart dog.
sentences.zh: 这只叫鲁尼的狗非常聪明。

sentences.en: And, yeah.
sentences.zh: 而且，对。

sentences.en: And she, like, she loves toys.
sentences.zh: 它非常喜欢玩具。

sentences.en: She's not food-motivated at all.
sentences.zh: 它对食物一点也不感兴趣。

sentences.en: She loves toys.
sentences.zh: 它只喜欢玩具。

sentences.en: But toys are not fun for her unless, like, the humans are playing with the toys, too.
sentences.zh: 但玩具对它来说只有在人类也陪着玩的时候才有意思。

sentences.en: Like, it has to be interactive.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，必须得有互动。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And, like, she's, yeah, she's pretty smart.
sentences.zh: 而且它，对，它挺聪明的。

sentences.en: Like, you know, like a ball gets, like, under, like, a table or something.
sentences.zh: 比如说，你知道的，如果球滚到桌子底下什么的。

sentences.en: She knows how to get the ball out from under the table.
sentences.zh: 它知道怎么把球从桌子底下弄出来。

sentences.en: I have a dog who figured out how to open the door in the barn.
sentences.zh: 我养过一只狗，它学会了怎么打开谷仓的门。

sentences.en: Because, like, one way you just push the door open.
sentences.zh: 因为，单向的话你只要把门推开就行。

sentences.en: It was, like, just the door in the barn.
sentences.zh: 那只是一扇谷仓的门。

sentences.en: It didn't have a doorknob.
sentences.zh: 它没有门把手。

sentences.en: So, it had a string tied to it that, like, through the whole, like, you could just pull it open and stuff.
sentences.zh: 所以上面系着一根绳子，穿过整个洞，你只要一拉就能把它拉开什么的。

sentences.en: And so, this dog figured out.
sentences.zh: 然后这只狗就学会了。

sentences.en: One way, you push the door open.
sentences.zh: 一个方向是把门推开。

sentences.en: And the other way, like, grab the string, the rope on the door, and pull it open.
sentences.zh: 另一个方向是抓住门上的细绳、绳索，把它拉开。

sentences.en: And it could open the door by itself.
sentences.zh: 它能自己把门打开。

sentences.en: I was, like, really cool.
sentences.zh: 我觉得真的很酷。

sentences.en: Smart dog.
sentences.zh: 聪明的狗。

sentences.en: Do you think I could teach the dog to do it on command?
sentences.zh: 你觉得我能教这只狗听指令开门吗？

sentences.en: Like, I'm carrying something.
sentences.zh: 比如我正拿着东西。

sentences.en: Hey, dog, open the door.
sentences.zh: 嘿，狗子，开门。

sentences.en: Like, we're standing.
sentences.zh: 我们就站在那儿。

sentences.en: The dog, like, would stare at me.
sentences.zh: 那只狗会盯着我。

sentences.en: He's, like, why aren't we opening the door?
sentences.zh: 它好像在说，我们为什么不把门打开？

sentences.en: I'm, like, my hands are full.
sentences.zh: 我说，我腾不出手来。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Smart dog.
sentences.zh: 聪明的狗。

sentences.en: But, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 不过，我也说不准。

sentences.en: We had a dog who could play the piano.
sentences.zh: 我们以前养过一只会弹钢琴的狗。

sentences.en: That's nice.
sentences.zh: 那挺厉害。

sentences.en: I mean, didn't play it well, but he could play the piano.
sentences.zh: 我是说，虽然弹得不是很好，但它会弹钢琴。

sentences.en: We had a parrot that could ride a horse.
sentences.zh: 我们还养过一只会骑马的鹦鹉。

sentences.en: Well, okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧，行吧。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm sure there's plenty of animals that you could put on a horse.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我确信有很多动物都可以被放到马背上。

sentences.en: But, like, could it, like, control the horse?
sentences.zh: 但是，它能控制那匹马吗？

sentences.en: Well, this is the thing.
sentences.zh: 关键就在这儿。

sentences.en: So, if you're in the horse world, right, you go to the horse shows, and they have all these contests that you do with your horse.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你了解马术圈的话，对吧，你去参加马术展，他们有很多和马一起进行的比赛。

sentences.en: And one of them is to run the barrels, right?
sentences.zh: 其中一项就是绕桶赛，对吧？

sentences.en: You have to – there's some barrels set up on the corral thing that you're doing this in.
sentences.zh: 你必须——在进行这项比赛的围栏里摆放了一些桶。

sentences.en: You have to run – you have to ride the horse as fast as you can around the barrels.
sentences.zh: 你必须尽可能快地骑着马绕过这些桶。

sentences.en: You have to do a certain pattern, right?
sentences.zh: 你必须按照某种特定的路线来跑，对吧？

sentences.en: You have to turn the right direction, do it the right pattern, and come back.
sentences.zh: 你必须转向正确的方向，按正确的路线跑完，然后回来。

sentences.en: And it's – who can do it the fastest, right?
sentences.zh: 这就是看谁能以最快的速度完成，对吧？

sentences.en: It's like a little – it's the same with, like, you know, catching a steer and all these other things they do in these horse shows and stuff.
sentences.zh: 这有点像……就像套小牛以及他们在这些马术展上做的所有其他事情一样。

sentences.en: Dying to know the connection to the parrot.
sentences.zh: 我太想知道这和鹦鹉有什么关系了。

sentences.en: Go on.
sentences.zh: 接着说。

sentences.en: So, my dad taught the parrot to ride the horse to do the barrels.
sentences.zh: 所以，我爸爸教那只鹦鹉骑马去完成绕桶。

sentences.en: So, no one on the horse – the horse would do the barrels, the right pattern correctly.
sentences.zh: 所以，马背上没有人——但马会去绕桶，而且能正确地按照路线完成。

sentences.en: And it was, like, a complicated pattern.
sentences.zh: 而且那是一条很复杂的路线。

sentences.en: And come back, and my dad was like, look, I've trained this parrot to ride a horse.
sentences.zh: 然后跑回来，我爸就说，看，我训练了这只鹦鹉骑马。

sentences.en: Really, he trained the horse.
sentences.zh: 说真的，他其实训练的是马。

sentences.en: Like, the parrot just sat there.
sentences.zh: 就像，鹦鹉只是坐在那儿。

sentences.en: He trained the parrot to not fly away and trained a horse to run the barrels by itself.
sentences.zh: 他训练鹦鹉不飞走，并训练马自己去跑绕桶。

sentences.en: So, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: That's what we do.
sentences.zh: 我们就是这么干的。

sentences.en: I have no idea at this point what I'm going to be calling these episodes.
sentences.zh: 我到现在都不知道我要给这些单集起什么名字了。

sentences.en: If we could just brainstorm for a second here.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能在这里头脑风暴一下的话。

sentences.en: Did you want to talk about C++ ever in this episode at all?
sentences.zh: 这一集里你到底还想不想聊 C++ 了？

sentences.en: We did talk a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我们确实稍微聊了一点。

sentences.en: Cancers, Dismemberment, Cancer, Dismemberment, and Horses.
sentences.zh: 癌症、肢体残缺、癌症、肢体残缺和马。

sentences.en: Because I think it's going to be, like, Tony's career, Tony's dad, Tony's dad's finger.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得标题会是：托尼的职业生涯、托尼的父亲、托尼父亲的手指。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Tony's parrot.
sentences.zh: 托尼的鹦鹉。

sentences.en: And the thing is, like, Tony has plenty of, like, amazing, awesome tech stories.
sentences.zh: 问题是，托尼有很多精彩绝伦的技术故事。

sentences.en: But Tony also has plenty of crazy life stories.
sentences.zh: 但托尼也有很多疯狂的生活故事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: One thing now, well, because we're a few minutes over, but no one's been saying they have to exit.
sentences.zh: 现在有一件事，好吧，因为我们已经超时几分钟了，但没人说他们必须离开。

sentences.en: You say a few minutes over.
sentences.zh: 你说超时几分钟。

sentences.en: You say that as if there is, like, a set agenda or schedule for when we record these things.
sentences.zh: 你说得好像我们录制这些东西有什么既定的议程或时间表似的。

sentences.en: I mean, you've booked a 90-minute time slot, and we are over that 90 minutes.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你预定了一个 90 分钟的时间段，而我们已经超过这 90 分钟了。

sentences.en: And Tony probably does need to go back to his family at some point.
sentences.zh: 而且托尼可能在某个时刻真的需要回到家人身边去。

sentences.en: Forget Tony.
sentences.zh: 别管托尼了。

sentences.en: I've got to go, like, cook.
sentences.zh: 我得去煮饭什么的。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，对。

sentences.en: There's a lot of things.
sentences.zh: 有很多事情。

sentences.en: Bryce's food.
sentences.zh: 布赖斯的饭。

sentences.en: That sounds more important than family.
sentences.zh: 听起来比家人还重要。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It's not my food.
sentences.zh: 不是我的饭。

sentences.en: I've got to cook for the...
sentences.zh: 我得为……做饭。

sentences.en: My family is full-grown now, so, you know.
sentences.zh: 我的家人现在都成年了，所以，你知道的。

sentences.en: As my girlfriend likes to say, the division of labor is I cook, she eats.
sentences.zh: 正如我女友喜欢说的，分工就是我做饭，她吃。

sentences.en: Nice.
sentences.zh: 不错。

sentences.en: Question.
sentences.zh: 有个问题。

sentences.en: So you were in Windsor.
sentences.zh: 所以你当时在温莎。

sentences.en: How did you...
sentences.zh: 你是怎么……

sentences.en: Did you go to Waterloo, and your family still stayed in Windsor?
sentences.zh: 你是去了滑铁卢，而你家人依然留在温莎吗？

sentences.en: We moved out of Windsor when I was eight or nine, which still didn't get me to Waterloo.
sentences.zh: 我八九岁的时候搬出了温莎，但这还没让我去到滑铁卢。

sentences.en: It got me to a town called Bothwell, which is...
sentences.zh: 它把我带到了一个叫博思韦尔的小镇，那个镇子……

sentences.en: Bothwell?
sentences.zh: 博思韦尔？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: It's like 1,000 people.
sentences.zh: 大概只有一千人。

sentences.en: It's between London and Chatham, for those people who know...
sentences.zh: 对于那些知道的人来说，它在伦敦和查塔姆之间……

sentences.en: Never even heard of Chatham, either.
sentences.zh: 我连查塔姆都没听说过。

sentences.en: I've heard of London, definitely.
sentences.zh: 我绝对听说过伦敦。

sentences.en: So, okay.
sentences.zh: 所以，好吧。

sentences.en: It's between London and Windsor.
sentences.zh: 它在伦敦和温莎之间。

sentences.en: Put it that way.
sentences.zh: 这么说吧。

sentences.en: There we go.
sentences.zh: 这就对了。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 行吧。

sentences.en: That's London, Canada, folks, just in case we're a little confused there.
sentences.zh: 各位，那是加拿大的伦敦，以防我们有点搞混了。

sentences.en: Yeah, like, both London and Windsor are, like, in Chatham, those are all England towns.
sentences.zh: 对，就像伦敦和温莎还有查塔姆一样，这些都是英国的地名。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Because, you know, people who came over here had no creativity.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，当年迁徙到这里的人没有什么创造力。

sentences.en: And so, this is kind of a funny thing that I...
sentences.zh: 所以，这其实是一件挺搞笑的事，我……

sentences.en: So, I grew up in a small town outside of, you know, left Windsor.
sentences.zh: 我是在离开温莎后，在一个小镇长大的。

sentences.en: The rest of my childhood is in this small town and in a log house instead of...
sentences.zh: 我的其余童年时光都是在这个小镇的一栋木屋里度过的，而不是……

sentences.en: In Windsor, we had a writing stable and people all the time.
sentences.zh: 在温莎，我们有马厩，周围总是有人。

sentences.en: Instead, we, like, lived in the middle of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们住在荒郊野岭里。

sentences.en: And then I went off to high school.
sentences.zh: 后来我上高中了。

sentences.en: And I remember in grade nine, in high school, I wanted to be an architect, right?
sentences.zh: 我记得在高中九年级时，我想成为一名建筑师，对吧？

sentences.en: Because I actually did art.
sentences.zh: 因为我其实学过美术。

sentences.en: I've always drawn and stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 我一直都在画画之类的。

sentences.en: Like, my high school art teacher was distraught when I didn't go to art school.
sentences.zh: 当我没去上艺术学校时，我的高中美术老师心碎了。

sentences.en: Like, she wanted me to go to Ontario College of Art.
sentences.zh: 她希望我去安大略艺术学院。

sentences.en: And I'm like, I'm going to take math and physics.
sentences.zh: 而我说，我要去学数学和物理。

sentences.en: She's like, what?
sentences.zh: 她说，什么？

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Why would you do this?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要这么做？

sentences.en: And I'm like, I like math and physics.
sentences.zh: 我说，我喜欢数学和物理。

sentences.en: But if you're good at art and you like math and physics, architect is a great, you know, a great job.
sentences.zh: 但如果你擅长艺术又喜欢数学和物理，建筑师是一个很棒的职业，你知道的。

sentences.en: Like, it fits everything.
sentences.zh: 它完美契合了这一切。

sentences.en: And I liked being outdoors.
sentences.zh: 而且我也喜欢待在户外。

sentences.en: And I liked, you know, I figured as an architect, you would sometimes be out, you know, on site.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢，你知道的，我想象着作为一名建筑师，你有时会去户外，你知道的，去到施工现场。

sentences.en: And, you know, you wouldn't be...
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你不会……

sentences.en: I was like, I'd never want to have a job where I sit behind a desk all day and stuff like that.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，我绝不想找一份整天坐在办公桌前之类的工作。

sentences.en: That's, you know, I grew up in the country.
sentences.zh: 那就是，你知道的，我在乡下长大的。

sentences.en: I want to stay there, right?
sentences.zh: 我想留在那儿，对吧？

sentences.en: And so, and then in grade nine, I looked up, where would you go to school for architecture, right?
sentences.zh: 所以，然后呢，在九年级时，我查了一下，学建筑要去哪个学校，对吧？

sentences.en: And in Canada, the best place to go is Waterloo.
sentences.zh: 而在加拿大，最好的去处就是滑铁卢。

sentences.en: It's the architecture school, right?
sentences.zh: 那是建筑学院，对吧？

sentences.en: I did not know that.
sentences.zh: 我当时不知道这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah, and in grade nine, I looked that up and I said, Waterloo, and that's like two hours away from home.
sentences.zh: 对啊，九年级时我查了那个，然后我说，滑铁卢，离我家大概有两个小时的车程。

sentences.en: And I was like, that's too far.
sentences.zh: 当时我就觉得，那太远了。

sentences.en: I don't want to go that far from home.
sentences.zh: 我不想离家那么远。

sentences.en: And I just dropped it out of my brain.
sentences.zh: 于是我直接把它从脑子里给划掉了。

sentences.en: I'm like, I'm not going to be an architect, you know?
sentences.zh: 我就想，我才不当什么建筑师呢，你知道吗？

sentences.en: And then eventually I ended up going up, I ended up living in Waterloo.
sentences.zh: 结果最终我还是上去了，我最后甚至在滑铁卢住了下来。

sentences.en: Like, I ended up going to school up here and then I just stayed up here.
sentences.zh: 就像是，我最后到这儿上学，然后我就一直呆在这儿了。

sentences.en: Wait, you did go to Waterloo though, right?
sentences.zh: 等等，不过你确实去过滑铁卢，对吧？

sentences.en: I actually went to Laurier, the tiny high school university down the road from Waterloo.
sentences.zh: 我其实去的是劳里埃，就是滑铁卢路那头那所小巧的高中大学。

sentences.en: I always thought you went to Waterloo.
sentences.zh: 我一直以为你是去滑铁卢的。

sentences.en: I took courses at Waterloo as well and courses in Guelph.
sentences.zh: 我也在滑铁卢选过课，在圭尔夫也选过。

sentences.en: I kept taking courses after I graduated.
sentences.zh: 我毕业后也一直在选课。

sentences.en: For all of our American listeners, these are places in Canada that I'm interested in.
sentences.zh: 对于我们所有的美国听众，这些都是我在加拿大利好的地方。

sentences.en: Well, so Waterloo, everyone in programming should know about Waterloo because it really is a top programming school.
sentences.zh: 好吧，滑铁卢，搞编程的每个人都该知道滑铁卢，因为它确实是一所顶尖的编程学校。
